enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves leg. Turns to right side. Snores. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies soap. Rinses face. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto it. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Wipes face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bread. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Takes out frying pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Puts eggs on plate. Takes toast from toaster. Places toast on plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Stands up. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Takes out socks. Takes out shoes. Closes closet. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens drawer. Takes out bag. Places bag on bed. Opens bag. Puts laptop into bag. Puts notebook into bag. Puts pen into bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Enters hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at hospital. Clocks in. Puts on scrubs. Attends handover meeting. Receives patient list. Walks to patient room. Washes hands. Greets patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Updates patient records on computer. Talks to patient about symptoms. Consults with doctor. Walks to next patient room. Washes hands. Checks vital signs. Updates records. Takes lunch break. Returns to work. Clocks out.
Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds water to pot. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Adds meat to pot. Stirs pot. Cooks soup. Turns off stove. Takes out bowl. Ladles soup into bowl. Places bowl on table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up dishes from table. Carries dishes to sink. Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies soap to sponge. Scrubs dishes. Rinses dishes. Places dishes in drying rack. Turns off tap. Wipes counter with cloth. Sweeps floor. Puts away leftovers in refrigerator. Wipes stove. Takes out trash. Ties trash bag. Carries trash to bin. Returns to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Picks up laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Browses internet. Watches video. Closes laptop. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Removes clothes. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Puts on pajamas. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.
Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves leg. Turns to right side. Snores. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep.
